lead.t: Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) accounts for 95% of oral cancers, is aggressive, and is linked to "field cancerisation." It has two main pathways: tobacco/alcohol (TP53 mutations) and HPV-related (HPV-16, p16 overexpression, better prognosis).
